confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Hostel anchors are least certain because Willemstad has thin budget-accommodation supply. Cocktail and wine are derived from beer using a local price-ratio basis (cocktail about 2.9x beer, wine about 2.7x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. FX value comes from an rba.gov.au homepage snippet with jumbled labels that I could not verify against the F11 table, so confirm it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Dutch Caribbean and English-speaking Caribbean island capitals with similar tourism-driven pricing, such as Oranjestad (Aruba) and Bridgetown (Barbados), adjusted for Willemstad's lower-season July timing and limited budget accommodation.
